written.Speak to {npc:3389} again to start the a: Speak to Regthar again to start the attack: the Kolkar charge the bunkers just west of him in waves. Fight beside the grunts until Warlord Krom'zar (elite, 20) arrives with two bodyguards, usually from the south, then click the banner over his body.
written.Sunscale Scytheclaws hunt the plains aro:
Sunscale Scytheclaws hunt the plains around the Raptor Grounds; they drop the horns. Mebok takes them when the escort brings you back to Ratchet.
South-east toward the coast: the stolen silver lies in a raptor nest north-west of Northwatch Hold.
written.The Grimtotem camp is just north of {npc: The Grimtotem camp is just north of Makaba, a short walk off the road: Ruffians and Mercenaries stand among the tents.
written.The antennae vanish fifteen minutes afte:
The antennae vanish fifteen minutes after they drop: kill the Silithid Swarmers and Creepers at the Field of Giants' mounds, just south of Jorn's thunderhawks, until you have five, then take them straight to Ruga Ragetotem in Camp Taurajo.
Careful: Silithid Swarmers (level 21-22) cast Silithid Swarm both in and out of combat, which brings several small adds. Silithid Creepers (level 20-21) periodically cast Silithid Creeper Egg in combat, which spawns extra adds.
written.The next guide goes north-east across th: The next guide goes north-east across the Barrens to the Mor'shan Rampart and Ashenvale.
The pools lie just north of Regthar. Walk into the water to explore them; the Laden Mushrooms for Helbrim grow around them. Kill every Kolkar you pass for bracers. Barak Kodobane stands in the Kolkar camp west of the pools.
written.West from the mine to {npc:9316}'s camp,: West from the mine to Wenikee's camp, then south down the road to the Crossroads.
written.West to the {area:383}. The Witchwing ha:
West to the Dry Hills. The Witchwing harpies nest all over them; any of them can drop a talon. Chen's Empty Keg lies in their hills. Savannah Prowlers hunt the plains between Regthar and the hills: take their claws on the way.
Careful: There are 2 Witchwing Ambushers (level 17-18). They stay stealthed with Sneak while out of combat.
written.West to {npc:3389}'s watch post on the K: West to Regthar's watch post on the Kolkar border.

The Crossroads is your base for this guide. Everyone you need stands within a few steps of the inn: Sergra by the inn, Helbrim and Gazrog by the north gate, then up the tower to Devrak, the wind rider master, Thork and Darsok, and Tonga at the south gate on the way out.
